note: kind answers_identical: the two answers are equal as JSON values; kind compare: rows matched by (rep, id, obs) of the tables listed (subjects: rep, id), restricted to ids and rep <= max_rep when given; relation equal: every listed field of every matched row equal (numbers bit for bit); relation differ: at least one matched row has a different value; eta_len: compare the first eta_len entries of eta. reversed_run_reference: the eta of the run 'reverse_random_effects' (b) in the order (v, cl), tolerance form |a - e| <= tol_exact * max(|e|, scale)

checks.name: threads_2
checks.why: 1 thread against 2 threads: the whole answer is identical bit for bit

checks.name: threads_7
checks.why: 1 thread against 7 threads: 60 cells (6 subjects x 10 replicates), 7 does not divide 60

checks.name: threads_64
checks.why: 1 thread against 64 threads: more threads than the 60 cells

checks.name: threads_default
checks.why: 1 thread against the default (the option omitted)

checks.name: subject_alone
checks.why: subject "4" alone equals subject "4" inside the design of six (every field of both tables)

checks.name: subject_order_reversed
checks.why: the subjects in reverse order give the same rows for every subject

checks.name: subject_removed
checks.why: removing subjects "1" and "2" changes nothing for the others

checks.name: replicate_prefix
checks.why: a run of 4 replicates equals replicates 0..3 of a run of 10

checks.name: replicate_prefix_one
checks.why: a run of 1 replicate equals replicate 0 of a run of 10

checks.name: error_model_change
checks.why: another error model leaves eta, eps and ipred unchanged

checks.name: lloq_change
checks.why: no LLOQ leaves eta, eps and ipred unchanged

checks.name: negative_change
checks.why: negative = zero leaves eta, eps and ipred unchanged

checks.name: append_random_effect
checks.why: appending ka at the end of random_effects (Omega extended by a last row) leaves the first two eta and all eps unchanged
checks.note: eta is compared on its first 2 entries; the individual parameters and the predictions differ (ka now varies), and are not compared

checks.name: reverse_random_effects
checks.why: reversing random_effects (with Omega reordered) changes the eta: eta_cl of the reversed run is not that of the base (a guard against a silent reordering)
